gaps.name: diff-prose
gaps.reason: The diff component has no wrapping variant: its lines always scroll sideways. A diff of prose (.md, .txt) is one long line per paragraph, unreadable at phone width unless it wraps; code keeps the component's own scrolling lines.

gaps.name: row-press
gaps.reason: The context menu says a long press on a row may open its More menu, but the list has no way to switch off the phone's own long press on a link (its preview, callout and text selection), which opens on top of the menu. This class switches those off on a Work row's link and draws nothing.
